title: JANUS Linear A v0.8 multi-implementation reconciliation

cross_implementation_comparison.reason_external_false: All implementations consume the same frozen transcription baseline.
cross_implementation_comparison.reason: Representations, partition hashes, hypothesis families, specialization statistics, support semantics, and multiplicity controls differ materially.

SA_RA2_reconciliation.canonical_observation: SA·RA₂ OUT-specialization passes the canonical novelty screen under all three family-corrected nulls but is NOT_EVALUABLE in HT_CONFIRM because 7 < frozen 8 occurrence minimum.
SA_RA2_reconciliation.supplementary_B_observation: SA·RA₂ OUT-specialization toward CYP is a support-qualified near-miss; endpoint rewire is highly unusual but row/document nulls are ordinary, so B selects nothing.
SA_RA2_reconciliation.supplementary_A_context: SA·RA₂ was already the left endpoint of the v0.7 A known-control motif SA·RA₂ -> GRA; A v0.8 sequence novelty finds no eligible novelty motif.
SA_RA2_reconciliation.interpretation: The identity recurs across different observables, but recurrence below or before the frozen confirmation gate is not replication. The combined evidence is consistent with a known-control/row-document structural shadow and does not justify lexical promotion.

governance_correction.correction: Its A/B scientific comparisons remain useful, but its premise that A+B were the mechanism that first closed canonical R2 is superseded. Canonical v2.3 and the canonical higher-order v0.8 execution already existed and had closed R2 before this reconciliation was registered.
governance_correction.reason_not_deleted: JANUS preserves governance mistakes and their corrections as part of the audit trail.
